title: Blue Bird in Minecraft-Style 3D World Game

requirements.text: Build a 3D Minecraft-style world using React Three Fiber with procedurally generated terrain made of voxel blocks (grass, dirt, stone, wood, leaves). Include a sky with sun, clouds, and ambient lighting to simulate a normal Minecraft overworld environment.

quotes: Make an game that you are a little blue bird in Minecraft (normal Minecraft)

acceptanceCriteria: A 3D voxel world is rendered using React Three Fiber and Three.js
Terrain includes grass-topped dirt blocks, stone underneath, and tree structures with wood and leaf blocks
Sky, sun, and ambient directional lighting are present
The world has a flat or slightly varied landscape resembling a normal Minecraft overworld

requirements.text: Create a playable blue bird character as the player avatar. The bird should be rendered as a small blocky/pixelated 3D model in Minecraft style (cubic body, blue feathers, small beak, wings). The camera should follow the bird in a third-person perspective.

quotes: you are a little blue bird in Minecraft

acceptanceCriteria: A small blue bird character is visible on screen as the player avatar
The bird model uses blocky/voxel aesthetics consistent with Minecraft art style
A third-person camera follows the bird as it moves through the world

requirements.text: Implement bird movement mechanics: WASD or arrow keys for horizontal movement, Space to flap and fly upward, gravity pulls the bird down when not flapping, and the bird can land on top of blocks. Add smooth wing animation when flying.
acceptanceCriteria: WASD or arrow keys move the bird horizontally
Pressing Space causes the bird to gain vertical lift (flap/fly)
Gravity pulls the bird downward when not flapping
The bird lands and rests on top of block surfaces
Wings visually animate during flight

requirements.text: Implement basic block collision detection so the bird cannot pass through solid blocks and correctly lands on top of surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: The bird collides with block surfaces and does not clip through them
The bird lands on top of grass and other solid block surfaces
The bird cannot fly through tree trunks or leaf blocks

requirements.text: Add on-screen HUD showing player controls (WASD to move, Space to flap) and a small mini-map or coordinate display to help the player navigate the world.
acceptanceCriteria: A HUD overlay shows key bindings for movement and flying
Player position or a simple orientation indicator is displayed on screen
HUD elements do not obstruct the main 3D viewport

requirements.text: Apply a Minecraft-inspired pixel-art visual theme throughout the UI: blocky fonts, earthy green and brown color palette for menus, dirt/grass block textures for UI panels, and a loading/start screen with the game title 'Blue Bird Craft' styled like a Minecraft title screen.
acceptanceCriteria: A start/title screen is displayed before gameplay begins, styled after Minecraft's title screen
UI uses a blocky pixel-art font
Color palette uses greens, browns, and earthy tones consistent with Minecraft
A 'Play' or 'Start Game' button is present on the title screen

constraints: All 3D rendering must use React Three Fiber and Three.js only — no external game engines
No backend persistence is required; the game is entirely frontend
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Actual Minecraft assets or copyrighted textures
World saving or loading from backend

required: Pixelated blue bird sprite facing forward with blocky Minecraft-style design, small beak, stubby wings, on transparent background (blue-bird-sprite.dim_128x128.png)
Minecraft-style grass block texture tile for UI panels and backgrounds, earthy green top and brown dirt sides (grass-block-tile.dim_64x64.png)
Minecraft-style title screen background showing a grassy voxel landscape at sunset with trees (title-bg.dim_1280x720.png)
